description:
Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is a global leader in power system protection, automation, and control technologies that help keep the electric grid safe, reliable, and secure. As a Product Engineer supporting wildfire mitigation initiatives, you will serve as the voice of the customer, helping shape product features, workflows, and documentation that solve real-world challenges. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with customers, researchers, power engineers, and R&D teams to advance wildfire monitoring and mitigation solutions, influence product development, and support technologies that improve grid resiliency and situational awareness. Through a combination of technical expertise, customer engagement, product validation, and innovation, you will help transform complex requirements into practical solutions that are intuitive, effective, and impactful.

 Primary Responsibilities 
 Serve as the primary contact for customers interested in partnering for wildfire mitigation research as well as support existing partnerships.
 Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of SEL automation, communications, and software products, their applications in the partnership projects, as well as other solutions on the market to provide customers with the best possible research setup.
 Act as the voice of the customer by understanding customer challenges, workflows, and requirements, in the automation, communication, and software domain and translating them into features, functionality, and user experiences.
 Work closely with R&D engineers to define product requirements, and ensure product features meet customer and market expectations.
 Maintain an operational understanding of automation architectures, communications systems, and software platforms used in utility environments.
 Develop expertise in data acquisition, storage, and visualization technologies such as InfluxDB, Telegraf, Grafana, and related software tools used to support wildfire mitigation research and monitoring applications.
 Collaborate closely with power engineers and researchers to develop solutions that support wildfire detection, monitoring, situational awareness, and grid resiliency initiatives.
 Prepare documentation guides, instruction manuals, release notes, technical papers, and customer-facing training materials.
 Perform product validation testing and approve validation results.
 Assist with developing concept documents, system architectures, and new product ideas within R&D.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 B.S. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
 2+ years of working knowledge of automation, communications, software integration, and/or electric utility systems.
 Understanding of industrial networking, communications systems, and automation practices.
 Familiarity with data collection, time-series databases, and visualization tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, Telegraf, or similar platforms.
 Excellent technical presentation, training, and writing skills.
 Strong customer-facing communication and relationship-building skills.
 Interest in customer workflows and translating customer needs into product features and documentation.
 Understanding of electric power systems and utility operations is a plus.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with SEL automation, communications, or software products.
 Experience with electric utility communications, SCADA, or system integration.
 Experience specifying graphical user interfaces and customer-facing software features.
 
 Location 
 This position has the option to be location in Pullman or Lynnwood, WA. 

 Pullman, WA - SEL corporate office is located in Eastern Washington where you'll enjoy an unmatched quality of life. Enjoy the smaller town life: country space, freedom from traffic, easy access to recreational activities in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests, as well as great schools and universities.

 Lynnwood, WA - This position is located in Lynnwood, WA, just north of Seattle. Enjoy the convenience of a vibrant suburban community with easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment, while staying close to the outdoor recreation and natural beauty the Pacific Northwest is known for. Lynnwood offers excellent amenities, great schools, and a high quality of life.
 
 
 Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work. 
 People are at the core of our company and we hire employee-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. 
 We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options.
 We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
 We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay.
 We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs.  
 Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits.
 
 
 Salary Range Data 
 We anticipate filling this position as a Product Engineer: $89,000 - $134,000 annually. Our compensation ranges are based on the responsibilities of the role. Starting pay is determined individually and considers factors such as relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and training. Candidates may be considered at different levels based on their background. As a result, pay may vary to align with the level of the role.
 
 
 Communication with Applicants  
 We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com .
 
 
 SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.
